meta.disclaimer: Compatibility verdicts are derived from published registry data and documented client behaviour. No connector was executed or audited.

connector.name: Touchstone by touchstone.cv
connector.registryDescription: Bitcoin-anchored, tamper-evident audit log for AI agents - record, disclose and verify actions.
connector.summary: Hosted at touchstone.cv over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace cv.touchstone. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: A Touchstone API key as 'Bearer tsk_...' — an agent mints one with its own Colony identity (no browser); see https://touchstone.cv/developers

env.name: TOUCHSTONE_RECORDER
env.description: Recorder public id (rec_...) to append to.

env.name: TOUCHSTONE_SUBJECT
env.description: The subject Colony sub whose key signs entries.

env.name: TOUCHSTONE_API_KEY
env.description: Touchstone API key (tsk_...) for the append/disclose REST calls.

env.name: TOUCHSTONE_SIGNING_KEY
env.description: Base64 Ed25519 seed. Signs locally — the key never leaves your machine. Use this or TOUCHSTONE_KEY_FILE.

env.name: TOUCHSTONE_KEY_FILE
env.description: Path to a file holding the base64 Ed25519 seed (alternative to TOUCHSTONE_SIGNING_KEY).

env.name: TOUCHSTONE_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the Touchstone API base URL (defaults to https://touchstone.cv).
